text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a methodological and applied study focused on assessing soil erosion and soil conservation status at the national scale in Portugal, integrating soil quality, potential soil erosion, and land use cover factors. The primary objective is not land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation; it does not implement multiple future scenarios of LULC prediction with quantitative spatial modeling and accuracy metrics. The study uses existing land use data (COS2015) and scenarios of soil cover protection (C-factor) assumptions, but does not conduct LULC change modeling or prediction. Therefore, it fails to meet the core inclusion criteria of primary focus on LULC prediction and future scenario simulation. It is also not a review article. Hence, it should be excluded.)
